title: Work Buddies and the Pact of Six
summary: On Monday, February 16, 2015, while the rest of the Bennett Hall suite attends morning lectures at CPI, twenty-seven-year-old Megan Brooks sets up her remote engineering workstation across the basement table from Jordan as his daytime work buddy—leading to an honest, affirming conversation where Jordan places the Pact of Six openly on the table.

scenes.title: The Pact of Six on the Table
